home.missionP1: El Salvador is in the middle of the greatest transformation in its 200-year history. But true transformation means nothing if it doesn’t reach the children.
home.missionP2: Today, most Salvadoran kids don’t finish sixth grade. Malnutrition and anemia claim the potential of our youth before they even turn five. In rural communities, the average education stops at sixth grade — not for a lack of talent, but for a lack of tools.
home.missionP4: On the outside, we are PupuserIA — the AI platform connecting the world to El Salvador. On the inside, that revenue fuels AI-powered tutoring, nutrition, energy, and technology for thousands of students — scaling toward nationwide reach for every child.
home.missionP5: We don’t just want to market El Salvador to the world. We want to raise the floor for every child inside it.
home.descP1: An AI-powered, full-stack platform that serves as the definitive AI-powered platform for El Salvador — combining immersive content, tourism commerce, real estate investment tools, and diaspora financial services into a single ecosystem.
home.descP2: The user enters as a curious visitor, converts into a traveler, and graduates into an investor. A proprietary AI Valuation Engine prices real estate in a market with zero comps data, while an AI Concierge provides bilingual trip planning, investment consulting, and property matching at scale.
home.descP3: Every transaction funds the Foundation Layer — a transparent, on-chain impact system that delivers AI tutoring, meals, school supplies, laptops, and solar energy to thousands of children in underserved pueblos.
home.impactStatement: PupuserIA exists because a country's transformation should be measured not by its GDP growth or tourist arrivals, but by whether a child in the most remote pueblo — from Morazán to Chalatenango — has the same chance to learn, grow, and build as a child anywhere else in the world.

eq.subtitle: Every transaction multiplies F. Here’s exactly how your money reaches children.

O.label: Outside money flowing into El Salvador

m.label: Platform capture rate
m.detail: 5-year roadmap: Year 1 ~0.5% (early adopters, niche tourism bookings), Year 2 ~1% (SEO traction, remittance beta), Year 3 ~1.5% (AI valuations live, diaspora portal), Year 4 ~2.5% (marketplace flywheel, government partnerships), Year 5 ~3%+ (category leader, network effects).

f.label: Blended fee across services
f.detail: Tourism bookings 15–20% (industry standard for OTAs), real estate referrals 5–6% (split with local agents), remittance transfers 1.5–3% (undercutting Western Union’s ~7%). The blended 12% covers: ~40% platform operations (servers, AI, engineering), ~25% founder/team, ~17.5% Foundation (α), and ~17.5% growth reinvestment.

alpha.label: Percentage allocated to Foundation
alpha.detail: 17.5% of every dollar of net revenue is locked into the Foundation from Day 1 — non-negotiable, encoded in smart contracts. This isn’t a pledge; it’s an on-chain rule. As revenue grows, the Foundation grows automatically. At 3% capture, that’s $7.87M/year flowing directly to children.

e.label: On-chain delivery efficiency
e.detail: 92% of Foundation funds reach children directly. Every disbursement is recorded on-chain (Bitcoin/Liquid sidechain), publicly auditable in real time. Smart contracts auto-release funds to verified school partners, meal programs, and device suppliers. The remaining 8% covers auditing, local logistics, and last-mile delivery to rural pueblos — far below the NGO industry average of 25–40% overhead.

eq.perChildDetail: $250/year per child covers: ~$120 daily school meals (WFP-benchmarked nutrition), ~$60 amortized cost of a ruggedized tablet with offline AI tutor, ~$40 solar charging and connectivity, ~$30 school supplies and program coordination. Each year of coverage means one more child stays in school, eats daily, and learns with AI — compounding into higher literacy, lower dropout rates, and a generation that breaks the cycle of poverty.
eq.bridgeDesc: Organic m growth + GOES/MINED matching + xAI grants + CSR pipelines.
eq.effectsDesc: 5k–50k+ kids/year get daily meals, durable tablet + offline AI tutor, and solar energy. Malnutrition drops, school completion surges, youth stay and build locally.
eq.tagline: Every transaction multiplies F. Honest, auditable math.

coverage.title: Data Coverage Gaps
coverage.subtitle: Identifying where property data, imagery, and infrastructure info is missing across El Salvador’s 262 municipios — prioritizing boots-on-the-ground research.
coverage.desertZonesDesc: Areas where imagery, listings, and information are hardest to find — these need boots-on-the-ground investigation.
coverage.highValueTargetsDesc: Start scrapers here for quickest results — these areas have the best existing online data.

step1.title: High-Value Scraping
step1.desc: Run scrapers on San Salvador metro, beach corridor, and Ruta de las Flores. Quickest ROI for data population.

step2.title: Municipal Partnerships
step2.desc: Contact alcaldías in Cabañas, northern Morazán, and Chalatenango for cadastral records, property tax data, and local market info.

step3.title: Drone Photography
step3.desc: Focus on data deserts — northern Morazán (Perquín), Chalatenango (La Palma), and Cabañas interior. ~$50/municipio for local operators.

step4.title: Community Researchers
step4.desc: Hire 3-5 local researchers ($300-500/month) to collect property prices, take photos, and document infrastructure in remote municipios.

step5.title: Satellite Imagery
step5.desc: Use Sentinel-2 or Planet Labs for development detection in areas with zero street-level imagery. Free tier for educational use.

step6.title: University Partners
step6.desc: UES, UCA, and UTEC have sociology/geography departments that could assist with field data collection as student research projects.

coverageBanner.desc: We’re tracking property data, imagery, and infrastructure info across every municipio in El Salvador. 6 data desert zones need field investigation.
